phases.name: Phase 0 — Walking skeleton
phases.description: A thin, deployed thread through every layer: repo and CI, AWS account, every CDK stack, Cognito sign-in, one API call that reads DSQL, the custom domain, backups. Ends deployed to dev and prod.

phases.name: Phase 1 — Foundation
phases.description: Sign-up (solo or partner), invites, sign-in, roles, the app shell, setup wizard steps 1, 2, 4, 5 and 9, and the JSON export.

phases.name: Phase 2 — Bills and paychecks
phases.description: The "within means" core: openMonth, bills, cards, paychecks, other income, money in/out. Real use in prod starts here, alongside the Google Sheet for one month.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Investments and money moves
phases.description: Holdings, options, dividends, splits, weekly money moves with carry-over, reinvest suggestions, bills covered.

phases.name: Phase 4 — Dashboard, accounts and months
phases.description: The dashboard with This week, the Accounts page with forecast and reconcile, the Start-a-new-month flow, locking and Unlock.

phases.name: Phase 5 — Year in review
phases.description: Year in review with projections, and the in-browser PDF.

phases.name: Phase 6 — Phone polish and empty states
phases.description: The phone-only flows, bottom sheets, remaining empty states and the accessibility audit.

tickets.title: Monorepo scaffold and quality gates
tickets.goal: pnpm workspace with `packages/domain`, `db`, `api`, `web`, `infra`; strict TypeScript; ESLint + Prettier; Vitest with per-package coverage thresholds; dependency-cruiser rules.
tests: A placeholder domain test fails, then passes (proves the red→green loop works)
dependency-cruiser fails when any package other than `db` imports `pg` or the DSQL connector
dependency-cruiser fails when `domain` imports anything from `db`, `api`, `web`, `infra` or any AWS SDK
done: `pnpm test`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm coverage` work from the repo root
Coverage thresholds set: domain 100/100, db and api 95/90, web 85/80
Node 24 pinned in `.nvmrc` and `engines`; README has the local setup steps
`design/` holds the PNG snapshot of the 15 screens (done Nov 19, 2026; see `design/README.md`)

tickets.title: Domain foundations: money, dates, week(), clock
tickets.goal: The building blocks every rule uses: integer-cents money, `formatMoney`, `Temporal.PlainDate` helpers, `ym` helpers, `week()`, and an injectable `Clock`.
tests: `formatMoney(123456)` → `$1,234.56`; `formatMoney(-92300, {whole:true})` → `−$923` with a true minus sign
`today(clock, 'America/New_York')` at 2026-12-01T02:00Z → 2026-11-30
`addMonths('2026-12', 1)` → `2027-01`; `monthOf(date)`, `daysInMonth` cover Feb in leap and non-leap years
Money helpers reject non-integer cents
done: A lint rule forbids `Date` in `packages/domain` and float math on `*_cents` identifiers

tickets.title: CI, branch protection and the PR review flow
tickets.goal: GitHub Actions workflow on every PR: install with cache, lint, typecheck, unit tests with coverage gates, dependency-cruiser, CDK synth. Stryker only when `packages/domain` changes. Branch protection on `main` (the repo is public, so it's free). The Claude review workflow on every PR.
tests: A PR that drops domain coverage below 100% fails the check (verify once with a throwaway PR)
Stryker job fails below a 90% mutation score
A direct `git push` to `main` is rejected (verify once)
done: Branch protection on `main`: require a PR; require status checks (the CI jobs) and up-to-date branches; require conversation resolution (so unresolved Claude review comments block the merge); allow merge commits only (Settings → General → Pull Requests: turn off squash and rebase merging); do not allow bypassing, including for admins
Claude review: run `/install-github-app` in Claude Code, choose the review workflow and a subscription token (`CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`); merge its PR; add `concurrency` so superseded reviews cancel
Settings → Actions → General: require approval for workflow runs from outside contributors (public repo: forks can open PRs)
`concurrency` cancels superseded CI runs on the same PR
`/merge-pr` and `/sync` tried once on this ticket's own PR
